scope: one configured chain and mission per gateway
signed_transport: UTF-8 JSON string; parse strictly before authenticating

a2a.authentication: operator bearer token; loopback or authenticated tunnel
a2a.send_response: submit/profile/inspect: direct Message; task: tracked Task
a2a.history: at most 64 durable observed updates; default zero; not consensus time
a2a.pagination: authenticated cursor; descending observed time; restart if changed
a2a.push: allowlisted HTTPS; public DNS pinning; three attempts then reconfigure
a2a.tenant: empty or the configured mission; no cross-mission routing

mcp.legacy: initialize handshake supported by the official SDK
mcp.completion: mission-visible identity prefixes for templates and review prompt
mcp.notifications: subscriptions/listen resource updates; disconnect then refetch
mcp.authentication: stdio process ownership; local bearer or OAuth resource server

errors.OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: submission may have committed; inspect before retrying
errors.REJECTED: node reported rejection; do not retry unchanged conditions
errors.UNAVAILABLE: no state observation; no execution authority inferred
errors.SCOPE: wrong mission or unsupported global governance
errors.NOT_FOUND: record absent, outside scope or ambiguous
errors.other: underlying CheckedFlow contract error; no implicit permission
